updates.note: Management mentions mid-single-digit value growth expectations for the remainder and full year period.
updates.quote: closer to the mid-digit level in terms of what we spoke about last time

new_promises.statement: We target 8 to 10 percent volume growth band for Q4 FY26.
new_promises.quote: band of 8- 10% for volume and gap between the volume and the value is a good indicator
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

new_promises.statement: We will endeavour to maintain the PBDIT margin band between 18 and 20 percent.
new_promises.quote: we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
